title: Classical Worst-Case Hardness Reduction for LWE
exact_target: Can a classical reduction match Regev's quantum LWE hardness reduction for both shortest-vector decision and independent-vector search without worsening its parameters or lattice dimension?

sources.citation: C. Peikert, 'A Decade of Lattice Cryptography', in Providing Sound Foundations for Cryptography: On the Work of Shafi Goldwasser and Silvio Micali, ACM Books, 2021, pp. 283-357; full version at web.eecs.umich.edu/\textasciitilde{}cpeikert/pubs/lattice-survey.pdf.
